title: nephrodium walkerae
intro: Nephrodium walkerae, commonly known as the Walkera's fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium walkerae involve its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential uses of this plant in modern medicine.
